text:
mara: FYI I opened PR #8234 to add a small 'burst_capacity' policy to the gpu nodepool TF module. trying to give short-lived jobs an extra 10% headroom without changing reserved capacity. can someone sanity-check the plan?

devin: looking now. is this the change that creates an additional autoscaled nodegroup or just a config flag on the existing pool?

mara: it's a flag that toggles an extra autoscaling group (spot) with a different label and taint, so we can route ephemeral workloads there. TF creates `redwood_gpu_burst_asg` with `max_capacity = floor(base_max * 0.1)` and `spot_preference = true`.

priya: can you paste the TF snippet + the k8s nodePool manifest you expect to apply? want to check taints/labels and IAM role binding for CSI/GPU drivers. :eyes:

mara: sure — excerpt from the module:```hcl
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra.git//modules/gpu-nodepool"
  base_max = var.gpu_pool_max
  burst_enabled = true
  burst_size = 0.1
  burst_instance_type = "g5.12xlarge"
  burst_spot = true
}
```

and the k8s part we plan to add to cluster-autoscaler config (helm values):```yaml
extraNodePools:
  - name: gpu-burst
    labels:
      node.kubernetes.io/gpu-burst: "true"
    taints:
      - key: gpu-burst=true:NoSchedule
    nodeSelector:
      accelerator: nvidia-gpu
    instanceType: g5.12xlarge
    capacityReservation: false
    spot: true
```

sam: quick Q — are burst nodes joining with the same KMS key access? we need to ensure the instance role can read the SSM secrets + KMS for model weights access. otherwise some inference jobs will fail.

mara: good catch. TF currently reuses the same iam_role_arn from the base pool, but the ASG user-data references SSM parameters path `/models/weights/*`. I added a note to attach `kms:Decrypt` in the role; PR has that policy addition.

devin: what about eviction handling? spot could be reclaimed and we have workloads that panic if preempted. are we planning to only schedule best-effort, batch jobs to this pool?

mara: yes — only batch/embeddings preprocessing will use `node.kubernetes.io/gpu-burst: "true"`. routing is enforced via pod nodeSelector + toleration. critical serving pods stay on the base reserved pool.

priya: can you show the toleration snippet you plan to add to the job manifests? want to ensure no accidental scheduling of critical pods.

mara: example toleration we'll add to batch templates:```yaml
tolerations:
  - key: "gpu-burst"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
```

sam: small nit — the taint key in the node manifest had `gpu-burst=true:NoSchedule` earlier, but toleration is for key `gpu-burst`. change to `key: gpu-burst` (no `=true`) to match standard k8s fields. otherwise it won't match.

mara: oof thanks, fixing that in branch. will update the TF to set taint key `gpu-burst` and taint value `true`.

devin: also, please add a short webhook test to the deploy pipeline that runs `kubectl get nodes -l node.kubernetes.io/gpu-burst=true` and asserts at least 1 node when burst_enabled=true. avoids surprises in staging.

mara: good idea. I'll add a post-apply smokecheck.

priya: LGTM after the taint key fix and IAM policy addition. Mara, can you also add a short note in the runbook about expected spot preempt window and recommended pod `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` and checkpointing?

mara: yep — adding runbook section: recommended `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120` and trainers should be checkpointing every 30s.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: terraform apply in infra/gpu-nodepool PR#8234 completed in staging — 1 burst node launched (g5.12xlarge-spot). Logs: `asg-attach: success`, `kubejoin: success`.

sam: nice. I'll watch for any failed pods and tag folks. :thumbsup:

mara: thanks everyone. posting a follow-up RFC doc with the visual flow (routing, fallback to reserved) and a short cost estimate for the burst pool. ping me for reviews.

devin: thanks — if no objections I'm ok to merge after the fixes.

priya: LGTM once the taint + IAM bits are adjusted.

mara: merging after updates, will notify when in prod. :rocket:
